meta.name: Option A (example)
meta.description: Example layout: workbench on the N wall in the workshop corner, shelving on the E wall, treadmill folded by the window.

workbench.note: R-001/R-002: back on W-N (rot 0 = front faces S), in Z-SHOP

tool-chest.note: N wall, west of the workbench

shelving.note: back on W-E (rot 270 = front faces W; turned, so w and d swap)

example-treadmill.note: R-003: stored folded, between the parking bay and the shelving
